The rs-fMRI scans selected from ABIDE I and ABIDE II cohorts were processed with the Configurable Pipe- line for the Analysis of Connectomes (C-PAC) [20] The Harvard-Oxford (HO) atlas was used to extract time series from brain regions, obtaining 110 timeseries for each subject. 62 structures (31 per hemisphere) from the Desikan-Killiany- Tourville Atlas
ASD/TD diagnosis is the underlying ABIDE site diagnosis; ADOS/ADI-R cited only in references, not described as an operational criterion applied here.

We esti- mated the NeuroHarmonize model parameters on the entire cohort of control subjects, by specifying the age as a covariate, whose effect is to be preserved during the harmonization process. Finally, we applied the esti- mated model on the entire sample of subjects with ASD and TD controls. This harmonization of structural and functional features was fit on the full cohort before the nested cross-validation split, so test-fold information informed the harmonization model, even though RobustScaler feature scaling and SHAP were confined to the inner CV loop.

risk_of_bias.summary: Well-documented multimodal pipeline (Freesurfer + C-PAC, named atlases) with nested CV and participant-ID release, but NeuroHarmonize site harmonization was estimated on the entire dataset (including what becomes test folds) prior to cross-validation, a leakage risk per PROBAST Analysis domain.

charting.title: Deep learning based joint fusion approach to exploit anatomical and functional brain information in autism spectrum disorders
charting.primary_goal: Classify ASD vs. TD using a deep-learning joint fusion of structural (Freesurfer) and functional (C-PAC) MRI features from ABIDE.
charting.dataset_openly_available: To allow the reproducibility of the analysis, the identification numbers (IDs) of the participants selected in the final sample are reported in Additional file 1.
charting.feature_types: Structural morphometry (221 Freesurfer features) and functional connectivity (5253 Fisher-z FC features)
charting.specific_features: Freesurfer aseg/aparc morphometric features (Desikan-Killiany-Tourville atlas) and pairwise Pearson functional connectivity (Harvard-Oxford atlas, 103 regions)
charting.feature_extraction_tools: Freesurfer v6.0 (recon-all) for structural; C-PAC for functional
charting.importance_method: SHAP (Gradient SHAP) applied within the inner CV loop, averaged over 100 folds; features above the 99th percentile selected as most important
charting.top_features_identified: brain changes tend to occur in individuals with ASD in regions belonging to the Default Mode Network and to the Social Brain.
charting.specific_algorithms: Feature-reduction neural network + classification neural network joint-fusion model, compared to single-modality (structural-only, functional-only) neural networks
charting.validation_methodology: Nested 10-fold cross-validation (inner loop for training/feature scaling/SHAP, outer loop for performance evaluation); site harmonization (NeuroHarmonize/ComBat) performed on the full cohort prior to CV
charting.performance_metrics: AUC, accuracy (mean ± SD across outer folds)
charting.key_performance_results: The AUC values of 0.66±0.05 and of 0.76±0.04 were obtained in the ASD vs. TD discrimination when only structural or functional features are considered, respectively. The joint fusion approach led to an AUC of 0.78±0.04.
charting.summary_key_findings: A multimodal deep-learning joint fusion of structural and functional MRI features (AUC 0.78±0.04) outperformed single-modality models (structural AUC 0.66±0.05; functional AUC 0.76±0.04) for ASD vs TD discrimination, with the most discriminative features localizing to the Default Mode Network and Social Brain regions.
charting.features_associated_disorder: brain changes tend to occur in individuals with ASD in regions belonging to the Default Mode Network and to the Social Brain.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I+II, 35 sites, 1383 males aged 5-40 (680 ASD/703 TD)
narrative_row.methods: Freesurfer v6.0 structural morphometry (Desikan-Killiany-Tourville) and C-PAC functional connectivity (Harvard-Oxford, 103 regions), NeuroHarmonize site harmonization, deep-learning joint-fusion feature-reduction + classification network, nested 10-fold CV, SHAP feature importance.
narrative_row.outcomes: Joint fusion AUC 0.78±0.04 outperformed structural-only (0.66±0.05, p<0.001 vs functional) and functional-only (0.76±0.04) models; top discriminative features in Default Mode Network and Social Brain regions.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Male-only sample; site harmonization (NeuroHarmonize) fit on the entire cohort prior to the nested CV split, risking leakage of test-fold information into the harmonization model.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Participant ID list published for reproducibility; demonstrates a multimodal structural+functional ABIDE classification pipeline with named atlases for both modalities.
